title: lotus sanguineus
intro: Lotus sanguineus, commonly known as the Indian lotus or Blue lotus, is a type of aquatic plant that belongs to the Nelumbo genus. This plant has been used for centuries in traditional medicine, particularly in Ayurveda and Unani, for its diverse health benefits, including reducing inflammation, relieving anxiety, and improving sleep. The therapeutic actions of Lotus sanguineus include its sedative, anxiolytic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as aporphine, nuciferine, and galbulimima. The bioactive constituents of Lotus sanguineus are responsible for its medicinal properties, making it a valuable herb in traditional medicine.
